If you were looking for the {{TPCi}} voice actor, see [[Craig Blair]].'' ---- [[File:Hamilton.png|thumb|250px|Hamilton in the subsequent airings]] '''Hamilton''' (Japanese: {{tt|'''ヒロキ''' ''Hiroki''|original airing}}, {{tt|'''タクヤ''' ''Takuya''|DVD release}}) is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP082|Cream of the Croagunk Crop!]]''. He was the defending champion of the [[Pastoria Croagunk Festival|Croagunk Festival]] in [[Pastoria City]]. Hamilton first came off as an arrogant boy. {{an|Brock}} overheard Hamilton apparently talking about marrying [[Nurse Joy]]. Angered by this, Brock interrupted the conversation, declaring that he will not let him marry Nurse Joy. Nurse Joy immediately corrected him, saying that Hamilton wanted his Croagunk, Craig, to marry her Croagunk, Chrissy. Brock decided to enter the competition with his {{TP|Brock|Croagunk}} to defeat Hamilton and win the love of Nurse Joy. Craig seemed equally matched to Brock's Croagunk and knew a variety of different moves. However, the competition was interrupted by {{TRT}}, who began to steal all of the Croagunk. Setting their differences aside, Hamilton, Brock, and Nurse Joy teamed up with their Croagunk to help. Eventually, it was Chrissy who saved the day. [[Crasher Wake]] decided that Nurse Joy was the winner for saving the festival, even though she didn't officially enter. Hamilton also agreed to Wake's choice. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Hamilton |pkmn=Croagunk |nick=Craig |gender=male |type1=Poison |type2=Fighting |img=Hamilton Craig.png |epnum=DP082 |epname=Cream of the Croagunk Crop! |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc=Hamilton's only known Pokémon is a {{p|Croagunk}} [[nickname|named]] '''Craig''' (Japanese: {{tt|'''グレキチ''' ''Gurekichi''|original airing}}, {{tt|'''グレッコ''' ''Gurekko''|all subsequent airings}}). Craig was the winner of [[Pastoria City]]'s Croagunk Festival one year ago and was awarded a crown and the throne that was granted to every winner. Craig appeared to be very affectionate towards his Trainer, clinging to Hamilton's chest while sitting on the throne. Hamilton had planned for Craig to marry Chrissy, the Croagunk that belonged to Pastoria City's [[Nurse Joy]], which made Brock stand up for Nurse Joy vowing to defend her and Chrissy from the arrogant Trainer. Called upon to defend his title, Craig put up a good fight against Brock's Croagunk, however the match was called off when Team Rocket attacked, and Craig teamed up with Brock's Croagunk to take on their giant mecha, only to be captured and later freed by Chrissy. Craig's known moves are {{m|Cross Chop}} and {{m|Dynamic Punch}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{poison color}}|bordercolor={{fighting color light}} |ja=沢海陽子 ''[[Yōko Sōmi]]'' |en=[[Jason Griffith]] |fi=Petrus Kähkönen |fr_eu=Ioanna Gkizas |it=Patrizia Mottola |de=Roman Wolko |no=Erik Skøld |pl=Wojciech Rotowski |pt_br=Vinícius Fagundes |es_eu=Carmen Podio |es_la=Jorge García}} ==Trivia== [[File:Blue Haired Hamilton.png|thumb|220px|''Hiroki'' in the original airing]] * Hamilton is based on a character named '''Hiroshi''' from the anime and manga {{wp|Dokonjō Gaeru}}. The story is about a boy who accidentally squashes a frog and now the frog's spirit lives on in an imprint on Hiroshi's shirt. Hamilton also bears an almost identical appearance to Hiroshi. ** Craig is a [[List of references to popular culture in Pokémon|reference]] to the frog, known as '''Pyonkichi''', because it did spend a lot of time on the front of his shirt. * Hamilton's appearance and even the Japanese names of both himself and Craig were changed shortly after the episode's initial airing in Japan. It is believed that it was to avoid a lawsuit from the producers of Dokonjō Gaeru. ==External links== * [http://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/comparisons/diamond_pearl/ep082_character-of-the-day.html The Hiroki/Takuya Change] at [[Dogasu's Backpack]]
